mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO kb_relation(src_ref, dst_ref, rel_type, rel_dimension, rel_source, src_label, dst_label, weight, create_time) VALUES
(#{r.srcRef}, #{r.dstRef}, #{r.relType}, #{r.relDimension}, #{r.relSource}, #{r.srcLabel}, #{r.dstLabel}, #{r.weight}, NOW())
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE src_label=VALUES(src_label), dst_label=VALUES(dst_label), weight=VALUES(weight), rel_dimension=VALUES(rel_dimension), rel_source=VALUES(rel_source)
